coverage: title + tagline + job relevance + 8 outcomes + 9 theory code/output blocks + 9 callouts + 1 figure

components.current_content: Browser RPA con Playwright
components.justification: Matches roadmap ownership.

components.current_content: robot contra sitio de prueba controlado, con trace de éxito/falla, download verificado y retries selectivos con handoff
components.improved_content: Robot Playwright ejecutado contra un sitio local controlado: descarga persistida y verificada, trace real de evidencia, retries seguros según el tipo de operación, checkpoint probado y handoff humano accionable.
components.justification: The current theory does not earn several nouns in the tagline.

components.current_content: Automatizar un sitio web controlado con Playwright significa elegir locators estables, dejar traces, reintentar con criterio y preferir la API pública antes que el clic cuando exista; sin evadir CAPTCHA ni ToS.
components.improved_content: Automatizar un sitio controlado con Playwright significa localizar controles mediante contratos resilientes, verificar postcondiciones y artefactos, conservar evidencia diagnóstica real y detenerse ante límites de política. Antes de usar RPA, evalúa si una API o exportación autorizada entrega el mismo dato con mejor trazabilidad. Si aparece CAPTCHA o el flujo deja de estar permitido, el sistema transfiere el caso a una persona.
components.justification: Removes universal API-exists⇒use-it language and reduces jargon.

components.current_content: Usar locators orientados a usuario
components.improved_content: Elegir locators user-facing o contratos testid según el requisito, y fallar ante cero o múltiples matches.
components.justification: Adds strictness and removes a one-size-fits-all ranking.

components.current_content: Aplicar auto-waiting y assertions fiables
components.improved_content: Distinguir actionability automática, web-first assertions y readiness de negocio, incluyendo timeout negativo con evidencia real.
components.justification: The current fake wait does not model Playwright's guarantees correctly.

components.current_content: Automatizar formularios, uploads y downloads
components.improved_content: Automatizar formulario/upload y persistir un download independiente con `save_as`, error check y validación de contenido/SHA-256 completo.
components.justification: The current fixture echoes the uploaded bytes and the real sketch loses the temporary download.

components.current_content: Modelar auth y Page Objects
components.improved_content: Reutilizar auth state como artefacto sensible y construir un Page Object real que envuelva `Page`, locators y acciones de alto nivel.
components.justification: The dict-only PO does not demonstrate Playwright POM or auth-state security.

components.current_content: Diagnosticar con trace, screenshot y logs
components.improved_content: Generar traces/screenshots reales, registrar logs estructurados y manejar retención/redacción de evidencia sensible.
components.justification: Path strings are not diagnostic artifacts.

components.current_content: Diseñar retries, recovery y reanudación por checkpoint
components.improved_content: Ejecutar retries solo cuando error y operación lo permitan, usar Locators en lugar de stale handles y demostrar checkpoint + idempotencia con un crash window.
components.justification: Current retry harness never invokes the operation and checkpoint exists only in prose.

components.current_content: Priorizar API/export sobre RPA
components.improved_content: Elegir API/export antes de RPA cuando sean equivalentes, autorizados, frescos y auditables, registrando la razón de integración.
components.justification: Availability alone is not a sufficient integration contract.

components.current_content: Respetar ToS/CAPTCHA y handoff humano
components.improved_content: Abortar cuando la automatización no esté permitida y generar un handoff persistido con run, step, checkpoint y evidencia suficiente para que una persona continúe.
components.justification: The blocker priority is good; the current handoff payload is incomplete.

components.current_content: Real Playwright sketch: launch Chromium, goto(base_url), click Exportar, expect_download on Descargar reporte, call download.path(), close browser, return path; then only prints sketch_ready/maps_to.
components.improved_content: Execute against a local fixture, start tracing, wait for download, call `download.failure()`, persist with `save_as`, validate the saved file, stop trace to a real ZIP, then close the context.
components.justification: The only real Playwright sample currently contains the section's most serious download bug and is not run.

components.current_content: Custom DOM lookup filters role/name and returns hits[0]; output b1 Descargar reporte / prefer_role_over_css True.
components.improved_content: Require exactly one match; add no-match and duplicate-match fixtures and a separate explicit testid path.
components.justification: First-match behavior is a dangerous mismatch with Playwright strict locator actions.

components.current_content: FakeClock + wait_until predicate loop; ready_at=250ms outputs ready True t 300.
components.improved_content: Use a deadline-bounded fake for custom readiness, include a timeout fixture, and keep real Playwright actionability/assertions as a separate browser test.
components.justification: Never-ready path exceeds the declared timeout and produces no promised trace.

components.current_content: Stores uploaded `synthetic-xlsx` bytes and the download function returns those same bytes' /tmp path, 12-hex SHA prefix and length.
components.improved_content: Model independent portal output and compare full SHA-256 plus parseable structure/content to an independently derived expected result.
components.justification: Current verification is tautological.

components.current_content: LoginPage/ReportPage wrap a dict ctx and authentication transitions; no Playwright Page or locator appears.
components.improved_content: Keep the state fake, then add a tiny real `LoginPage(page)` with locators and a gitignored sandbox storage-state fixture.
components.justification: The code models auth state but not the advertised Page Object pattern.

components.current_content: on_failure returns deterministic trace/screenshot path strings and console[-3:] without creating files; output reports .zip path and .png suffix.
components.improved_content: Create the trace/screenshot in the real controlled run, verify artifact existence/hash, filter structured logs, attach run_id and apply retention/privacy policy.
components.justification: The output is metadata fiction rather than evidence.

components.current_content: should_retry accepts timeout/network/429; run_with_retry takes fn but never calls it and walks a scripted error list.
components.improved_content: Invoke a deterministic operation fake per attempt, classify error+operation, honor backoff, check postconditions/idempotency and persist checkpoint/crash-window tests.
components.justification: A retry harness that never runs the function cannot validate retry behavior.

components.current_content: choose_integration returns api/export/rpa/human from availability booleans; output is api, export, human.
components.improved_content: Return a decision record only after equivalence, authorization, freshness and policy checks, including method/reason/evidence.
components.justification: Current code does not implement the reason/runbook contract described by prose.

components.current_content: handle_blockers prioritizes ToS abort, CAPTCHA human_handoff, ui_changed human_handoff; returns only action/reason/queue.
components.improved_content: Keep blocker priority but attach safe URL, step, run_id, last checkpoint, actual screenshot/trace refs and allowed next actions.
components.justification: The policy is good but the handoff is not actionable.

components.current_content: Graded exercises use dicts; local Playwright uses get_by_role, downloads and real traces; sketch is API form and not run in grader.
components.improved_content: Usa dicts para lógica pura, pero exige además un smoke test Playwright real contra el sitio local para locator strictness, download y trace.
components.justification: Dict-only evidence does not satisfy the roadmap gate.

components.current_content: Si no hay rol, el producto también es menos usable para personas; fíjalo con el equipo de UI.
components.improved_content: Roles/labels suelen producir locators cercanos a la experiencia del usuario, pero un locator semántico no certifica accesibilidad y un testid explícito también puede ser el contrato correcto.
components.justification: Removes false equivalence.

components.current_content: Un sleep de 5 s falla en CI lento y desperdicia tiempo en CI rápido. Prefiere condiciones.
components.justification: Correct and well scoped.

components.current_content: No basta con que el clic no falle: chequea tamaño, extensión o hash del download.
components.improved_content: Persistir el download y validar un contrato independiente: error de descarga, tipo/nombre esperado, parseo, tamaño razonable y SHA-256 completo; no basta un hash calculado sobre el mismo input.
components.justification: Current wording permits weak or tautological checks.

components.current_content: Si cambia el label del botón, tocas un solo método, no 40 tests.
components.improved_content: Un Page Object real centraliza los locators y acciones de una pantalla; el beneficio aparece solo si esos locators viven efectivamente dentro del objeto.
components.justification: The associated code does not demonstrate this property.

components.current_content: El adaptador web de CP-N2-C exige trace de éxito y de falla que otro analista pueda abrir y reproducir.
components.improved_content: El portfolio conserva al menos un trace de éxito y traces de fallos relevantes, generados realmente y bajo una política de datos/retención; otro analista debe poder abrirlos.
components.justification: Avoids implying tracing every successful production run while preserving the curriculum evidence requirement.

components.current_content: CAPTCHA y ToS son stop conditions → handoff humano, no loop.
components.justification: Responsible boundary; retain.

components.current_content: Cada flujo RPA debe tener ticket de reemplazar por API cuando exista.
components.improved_content: Cuando aparezca una API/exportación equivalente y autorizada, abre un ticket para evaluar migración desde RPA.
components.justification: API existence alone is insufficient.

components.current_content: Automatizar login en contra de ToS o resolver CAPTCHA con granjas no es aceptable en este curso ni en producción responsable.
components.justification: Clear responsible-use boundary.

components.current_content: Under T1-B Auto-waiting y assertions. Caption: CAPTCHA is not transient; human handoff. Alt: login→form→export→verify with a boundary after export where the effect already exists in the portal.
components.improved_content: Move this recovery/idempotency figure to T3-B or T4-B. For T1-B use a diagram of locator→actionability checks→action→web-first assertion→timeout evidence.
components.justification: The only diagram dual-codes a later recovery topic instead of the current auto-wait/assertions concept.
